about.title: Locally owned, right here in the Gorge
paragraphs: Columbia River Gorge Concrete and Excavation LLC is a locally owned and operated concrete and excavation contractor proudly serving the Columbia River Gorge and surrounding communities in Washington and Oregon.
With years of hands-on industry experience, our team is committed to high-quality workmanship, dependable service and efficient project completion.
We're fully licensed, bonded and insured in both Washington (#605515910) and Oregon (#251600), and we follow strict safety standards on every job.

estimate.title: Tell us about your project
estimate.text: Send us the details and we'll get back to you with a free estimate. We're open Monday to Saturday, 8am–6pm.
estimate.thanks: We got your project details and will reach out soon.

services.name: Custom Concrete & Flatwork
services.blurb: Driveways, patios, walkways, steps and slabs.
services.intro: Whether you're looking for a new driveway, patio, walkway, steps, fire pit, planter boxes or an outdoor kitchen slab, we deliver precision craftsmanship and durable results.

services.name: Foundations
services.blurb: Foundations for homes, shops, garages and commercial buildings.
services.intro: A strong foundation is the most important part of any structure. We excavate and pour foundations with proper grading, footing preparation and reinforcement.

services.name: Retaining Walls
services.blurb: Retaining walls that improve drainage and stop erosion.
services.intro: Retaining walls that improve drainage, prevent soil erosion and increase usable space, built for your soil conditions and load requirements.

services.name: Excavation & Grading
services.blurb: Grading, backfilling, foundation prep and heavy material moving.
services.intro: Because we specialize in both excavation and concrete, we streamline your project from site preparation to final pour.

services.name: Land & Site Clearing
services.blurb: Tree and stump removal, brush clearing and home site leveling.
services.intro: Getting a lot ready to build? We clear and level home sites.

services.name: Utility Trenching & Septic
services.blurb: Utility trenching and septic tank installation.
services.intro: Utility trenches dug and backfilled, and septic tanks installed.
